content.short: ether.fi pairs liquid restaking with a non-custodial credit card, letting users save, earn and spend without giving up their keys.
content.description: ether.fi started as a liquid restaking protocol where stakers keep control of their own keys, issuing weETH for ETH, eBTC for Bitcoin and eUSD for stablecoins, with Liquid vaults rotating deposits across DeFi strategies. It has since built consumer banking on top of that base under the name Cash, a non-custodial Visa credit card that pays up to 3 percent back and spends against staked collateral rather than forcing a sale. Each cardholder gets a personal Safe vault on OP Mainnet that only they control. The Club wraps it all together with membership tiers, higher limits and travel benefits.
content.meta: ether.fi combines liquid restaking with a non-custodial credit card and membership tiers. Discover ether.fi and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
